name: Sicilian Defense
description: Fight for the center from the side. The Sicilian creates unbalanced positions where Black plays to win, not just to equalize. It's the most popular answer to 1.e4.

lessons.title: Open Sicilian: the Najdorf setup
lessons.summary: Trade your c-pawn for White's d-pawn, then play ...a6.

moves.note: White opens with the king's pawn.
The Sicilian: control d4 from the side and unbalance the position.
White develops and prepares d4.
Guard e5 from White's pieces and free your light-squared bishop.
White opens the center.
Take! You trade a side pawn for a center pawn, which is a good deal.
White recaptures with the knight.
Develop with tempo: you attack e4.
White defends e4.
The Najdorf move: take b5 away from White's pieces and prepare ...e5 or ...b5.

lessons.title: Against the Alapin (2.c3)
lessons.summary: Hit e4 with your knight, then trade on d4.

moves.note: White opens with the king's pawn.
The Sicilian.
The Alapin: White wants d4 and to recapture with a pawn.
Attack e4 immediately, before White can play d4.
White chases your knight.
The knight lands on d5. It's safe there because White's pawn is on c3, not c4.
White builds a center.
Trade pawns so White's center can't stay flexible.
White develops before taking back.
Develop and pressure e5 and d4.
White recaptures, keeping pawns on d4 and e5.
Strike at e5 and open lines for your pieces.

lessons.title: Against the Grand Prix (f4)
lessons.summary: Fianchetto your bishop and stay solid against the kingside attack.

moves.note: White opens with the king's pawn.
The Sicilian.
White develops the knight first, with f4 in mind.
Natural development that controls d4.
The Grand Prix Attack: White plans a fast kingside attack.
Prepare to put your bishop on the long diagonal.
White develops.
Your bishop now pressures d4 and b2 from far away.
White aims the bishop at f7.
Blunt the bishop. f7 is covered and the c4 bishop hits a wall on d5.
White castles.
The knight goes to e7 so it supports ...d5 and doesn't block your bishop. Next you castle.

lessons.title: Against the Moscow (3.Bb5+)
lessons.summary: Block with your bishop, trade, and strike with ...d5.

moves.note: White opens with the king's pawn.
The Sicilian.
White develops.
Guard e5.
White checks to trade pieces and avoid the main lines.
Block with your bishop and offer a trade.
White trades.
Recapture with the queen and keep c6 free for your knight.
White castles.
Develop and control d4.
White prepares d4.
Develop and hit e4.
White defends e4.
Prepare ...d5 and open a path for your dark-squared bishop.
White opens the center.
Trade pawns.
White recaptures with the c-pawn.
Hit back in the center. Now e4 is under real pressure.
